title: myrcianthes fragrans subsp. simpsonii
intro: Myrcianthes fragrans subsp. simpsonii, commonly known as the Chilean guava, is a plant species native to the Andes mountains in South America. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and infections, due to its health benefits such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Myrcianthes fragrans subsp. simpsonii include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it effective in wound healing and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
